headline: Xeltis raises an additional €20.5m of funding to advance aXess™ toward FDA approval and US commercial launch
summary: New investor Horizon 3 Healthcare led the round, which was supported by the European Innovation Council, Invest-NL, VI Partners, EQT Life Sciences, DaVita and other current shareholders Builds on the €50m secured in 2025 and supports Xeltis’ next phase of clinical, regulatory and commercial executionAdditional €20.5m provides the runway to finalize the ongoing US pivotal trial of aXess™, prepare for FDA submission and US Go-To- Market, fund the European commercial rollout of aXess™, upscale manu
